integrity: The face census is checked independently by the matrix-forest theorem, and every mod-2 boundary rank is recomputed by two elimination orders from the complete finite chain complex.
scientific_limitations: The theorem is restricted to reduced homology of the Petersen graph Morse complex with coefficients in \(\mathbb F_2\).
No integral-homology, torsion, wedge-decomposition, or complete homotopy-type statement is asserted.
title: Mod-2 homology of the Petersen graph Morse complex
